newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Showers seen over parts of Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Showers seen over parts of Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department said there were no rains in hydro catchment areas in the past 24 hours ending Monday morning.
It forecast isolated showers in western and southern provinces on Tuesday.
Isolated showers will develop in the Central, Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces, particularly during the afternoon and evening on Tuesday, it said.
